docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY HANSEN, DEBRA AS TO DEFENDANT KEFFER, LARRY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-11-2002 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 506
TRIAL RESET TO MAR-04-2002 AT 05:30 PM IN DEPT 506 TRIAL OF FEB-11-2002 IS TAKEN OFF CALENDAR
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT KEFFER, LARRY

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS TO DEFENDANT KEFFER, LARRY PLTF APPEARED & ADVISED THE COURT THAT THE PARTIES HAVE SETTLED THIS CASE EARLIER TODAY. DEFT HAD GIVEN PLTF A CHECK IN FULL SATISFACTION OF HER CLAIM AND THE CHECK HAD BEEN DEPOSITED. CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
